audience: HR and people teams that track engagement and recognition in Happily.ai

useCases.title: Review the engagement of a team member
useCases.text: Find a member and read the engagement profile of that person.

useCases.title: Summarize survey responses
useCases.text: List the survey questions and the responses. Ask the assistant for the main themes.

useCases.title: See who gets recognition
useCases.text: List the recognition that people received and open a medal to see what it means.

useCases.title: Send recognition to a colleague
useCases.text: Send recognition with a medal and a message to a team member. This gives coins to the receiver.

useCases.title: Read performance feedback
useCases.text: List the performance feedback of the company to prepare a review.
